name: artcraft_upload_video
description: Upload a local video file for use as a generation reference. Reads a local file and sends it to ArtCraft; requires confirm: true. File must live inside the user's home directory (or ARTCRAFT_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS), be a video type, and be <= 512 MB.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this local file may be read and uploaded.

file_path.description: Local path to a video (mp4/mov/webm/mkv/m4v) inside an allowed directory
